about: A condition never reads profile text (chapter 3 § 3.4.6). The call signed passes profile.signature to the function sign, so its value carries profile text; the computed node signed_length runs when its if holds. Invalid: the if reads node.signed.content. Valid: input.consult_draft.content.
sentences: Node 'signed_length' reads node.signed.content, which carries profile text; prompts, parts and conditions don't read profile text.
